items.headline: Mega Evolution—Pitch Black Launches July 17
items.summary: The fifth Mega Evolution expansion released worldwide on July 17, 2026, featuring over 115 cards headlined by Mega Darkrai ex. Prereleases ran July 4-12 with strong early demand for dark-themed Megas and Illustration Rares. Official previews highlighted Mega Zeraora ex, Mega Chandelure ex, and new Trainer support.
action: Monitor sealed ETBs and Booster Bundles for short-term flips as supply stabilizes
Target Mega Darkrai ex singles or SIR variants for competitive/meta play

items.headline: 30th Celebration Set Card List Leaks
items.summary: Scans and full card list for the September 16 global 30th Celebration expansion leaked in mid-July. The set introduces Futuristic Rare rarity, 30 classic reprints, 30 unique Pikachu cards, and new ex like Greninja ex and Umbreon ex. First simultaneous worldwide TCG launch.
action: Watch for pre-order drops on Pokémon Center; avoid overpaying on early secondary market
Prioritize sealed anniversary products for long-term collector demand

items.headline: Chaos Rising Products Show Strong June-July Performance
items.summary: Booster Bundles and ETBs from the May 22 set maintained robust restock activity and 20-32% projected ROI through July, driven by Mega Greninja ex promos and tournament play. UK and US markets reported solid liquidity and sealed demand.
action: Consider adding Chaos Rising sealed at current levels for continued appreciation
Track TCGPlayer sold listings for key ex singles

items.headline: First Partner Illustration Collection Series 2 Released June 19
items.summary: Series 2 of the starter-focused illustration promo collection launched with Johto, Unova, and Galar starters. Each pack includes three exclusive promos, two boosters, and a sticker sheet, continuing the art-centric collector line.

items.headline: Pokémon 30th Anniversary McDonald's Japan Collab Begins
items.summary: McDonald's Japan launched a Pokémon 30th Anniversary collaboration in mid-July featuring themed items and likely promo tie-ins. This adds to broader anniversary momentum boosting sealed and chase card interest.
action: Watch for any global spillover or secondary market promos

items.headline: Pitch Black Card Previews Released by Pokémon
items.summary: Official sneak peeks on July 10 highlighted powerful new Megas including Mega Darkrai ex and Mega Delphox ex ahead of the July 17 launch. The set emphasizes darker themes tied to Legends Z-A.
